title:
Transform for updating alert muted status display in alert detail pages.

This transform processes alert data to convert boolean `isMuted` values into
localized string representations for consistent display across the UI. It handles
the muted status for triggering models, sensors, and the main alert object.

## Processing
The transform updates the `isMuted` field for:
- `triggeringModel`: The model that triggered the alert
- `sensor`: The sensor associated with the alert (for sensor health alerts)
- Main data object: The primary alert object

## Output
Returns the input data with updated `isMuted` fields containing localized strings:
- `'Reliability.Muted'` for muted alerts
- `'Reliability.Unmuted'` for non-muted alerts
name: ManageAlertStatusTransform
